meta.title: ULTIMATE Vietnam Travel Guide 2026 for Indians 🇻🇳 #vietnam #travel #vietnamtrip
meta.description:
Planning a trip to Vietnam in 2026?
We have cover everything you need to know before planning your Vietnam trip from India in this video. Whether you're planning a budget Vietnam trip, a family vacation, or a backpacking adventure, this guide will help you plan the perfect itinerary.

We discuss Vietnam visa requirements, flights from India, SIM cards, food options (including vegetarian food), transportation, accommodation, travel tips, and estimated travel expenses.

We also cover the best places to visit in Vietnam, including destinations in North Vietnam, Central Vietnam, and South Vietnam. If you're planning to explore Hanoi, Da Nang, Hoi An, Ha Long Bay, Ninh Binh, or the Ha Giang Loop, this video will help you plan your journey step-by-step.

This is the first video in our Vietnam travel series, where we share our complete travel experience, itinerary planning tips, and practical advice. In our upcoming videos, we will also cover Phu Quoc Island and more hidden gems in Vietnam.

So if you're searching for:
• Vietnam travel guide from India
• Vietnam itinerary 2025 / 2026
• Vietnam trip cost from India
• Best places to visit in Vietnam
• Vietnam visa for Indians
• Hanoi travel guide
• Ha Long Bay travel tips

…then this video is perfect for you!
